author: 4ce_
body:
IGN: IcyPhoenixYT
Reason: I was banned for Hacking
Why I should be unbanned: I think I should be unbanned because I love this server and I love playing Nebulas. What I did was wrong and I shouldn't have done it in the first place. I was using hacks to my advantage and it is unfair to me and the others around me. I wish I had a second chance because if I did, I would immediately delete my hacked client and play fair. I know this server doesn't allow hackers and I promise you will never see me hack again! This is why I think I should be unbanned.
